title: Podcast EP373: The Impact of yieldHUB Live and Details of Upcoming Show Participation with Gillian O'Donnell
text:
Podcast EP373: The Impact of yieldHUB Live and Details of Upcoming Show Participation with Gillian O’Donnellby Daniel Nenni on 10-09-2026 at 10:00 am

Categories: EDA, yieldHUB

Daniel is joined by Gillian O’Donnell, Director of Growth at yieldHUB, the enterprise yield management platform trusted by semiconductor and photonics manufacturers worldwide. She leads business development, marketing, PR, and partnerships, with a particular focus on yieldHUB Live, the company’s real-time test floor intelligence solution. Gillian’s path into yield began with data. She joined yieldHUB as a data scientist and contributed to the development of yieldHUB Live, which gives manufacturers real-time insight into their test floor while production is still running. She loves being close to the work and has spent time on high-volume test floors alongside customers as they improve yield and tester capacity.
Dan explores the architecture, capabilities and impact of yieldHUB Live with Gillian, who describes the substantial impact the platform has had on many customers along with its ease of setup and use. She details significant information about a new customer case study being published on the impressive results of yieldHUB Live usage in a real production setting. She also discusses yieldHUB’s participation in the upcoming Semicon West and International Test Conference (ITC) events.
Semicon West will be held October 13-15, 2026 at Moscone Center in San Francisco, CA. You can find out more about Semicon West and register to attend here.
ITC will be held October 11-16, 2026 at The Grand Hyatt River Walk in San Antonio, TX. yieldHUB will exhibit in booth 602. You can find out more about ITC and register to attend here.
